messages.subject: fileInput
parts:
Hi there,  

I am a little confused to what needs to be in the accept argument of fileInput. I would like to be able to accept multiple file extensions that are all text files (for example, *.txt, *.phy, and *.snps).  I have the following included with my ui.R script:

fileInput("SNPdataset", "Choose File To Upload (.phy, .nex, .txt, .snps):", accept=c("text/csv", "text/comma-separated-values", "text/plain", ".txt", ".nex", ".snps")),

On Safari, I can only click on *.txt files (others are gray).  On Chrome, I can never click *.nex files and can only sometimes click *.snps files.  

I can't seem to find much on what this function argument is doing other than looking for mime type.  Any help is appreciated.
Barb
